$description: Rhythm / position rules a JSON Schema cannot express. Every rule id here is implemented under the same id in schema/semantic_validate.py (GRAPH_RULE_IDS); extraction/verify_all.py fails if the two sets differ.

rules.rule: shell.site-header, when present, is the first node.
shell.site-footer / shell.campaign-footer, when present, is the last node.
At most one HERO-category node per page.
rules.exceptions: Templates with hasHero=false (blog-index, blog-article, case-study, contact, legal-document, job-detail, job-application, embed-shell) must have zero HERO nodes; their openers are EDITORIAL/CONTENT/CONVERSION.

rules.rule: The HERO node is the first node after the header (or the first node when the template has no header).
structure.hairline-divider never directly follows another divider and never sits directly after the header. (A divider directly before a footer is real: /fcb/x/thank-you.)
conversion.closing-cta and conversion.team-closer are immediately followed by the site footer.
Template product has exactly one features.product-cross-sell (all four product routes do: /ai-os, /agents, /systems, /ai-gateway).
retrievalEligible=false sections appear only in overlays[].
rules.exceptions: utility.third-party-embed-slot is the in-flow body of template embed-shell.

rules.rule: Two adjacent nodes should not share a category.
rules.exceptions: Categories FEATURES, EDITORIAL, CONTENT, STRUCTURE and TESTIMONIAL repeat legitimately (product bodies, article chapters, legal sections, country columns); careers has conversion.apply-contact followed by conversion.closing-cta; home has social-proof.logo-grid followed by social-proof.case-study-carousel.

rules.rule: At most 3 nodes per page use a continuously looping pattern (video-loop, lattice-loop, globe-autorotate, gradient-blob-spin, canvas-shader-loop). Home uses 2 in nodes (video-loop, lattice-loop).
